$comment: The locales the real-UI assets are rendered in: the same ones as LOCALES in src/locale.tsx. snapshotLocale is what render-ui.sh passes to Gradle as -PsnapshotLocale (null: none, the harness's en-US); it must match a PromoLocale tag in PromoSnapshots.kt. extensionLocale is the browser extension's _locales folder the popup is rendered with. See docs/ASSETS.md.
